title: Points, Lines and Angles: cheat sheet

blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Points, lines and planes are the building blocks. Angles are measured in degrees, and special pairs of angles let you find unknown angles by reasoning instead of measuring.

blocks.title: Basic figures
items: Ray: one endpoint, goes on forever
Plane: a flat surface that goes on forever

blocks.title: Angle pairs
items: Linear pair: side by side on a line, add to $180^\circ$

blocks.body: A proof is a chain of statements, each with a reason. One counterexample disproves a claim, but examples alone never prove it.
